name: AiSDR
long_description:
AiSDR builds Ami, an AI sales agent that helps B2B companies find customers and book meetings.

Give Ami your website. It researches your business, recommends who to target and why now, and builds an outreach plan. Once you approve, it runs personalized campaigns across email and LinkedIn, follows up, handles replies, and books meetings.

Ami keeps working after launch. It monitors results, spots problems with targeting or messaging, and recommends changes or applies them within the rules you set. It remembers your decisions and campaign results, so each campaign builds on the last.

Built on lessons from 17,000+ real AiSDR campaigns, Ami gives founders and small teams sales strategy and execution in one place, without having to manage every step themselves.
one_liner: AI that finds the right buyers and books sales meetings
